main.description: Retracts a label by writing a negating one. The original label record is left in place.

space.description: The space the labelled record lives in.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the label.apply permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: No space exists at the given reference.

errors.name: LabelNotFound
errors.description: No active label matching the subject and value exists to negate.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.
